ai_summary: Augmont Enterprises Limited recently completed its transition to a public company, listing on BSE and NSE effective August 31, 2026, necessitating a routine change in its Corporate Identification Number (CIN) from unlisted to listed status. The company reports substantial authorized and paid-up capital and actively manages its finances, with current outstanding charges appearing manageable and largely set for satisfaction by mid-2025. This document is a procedural update reflecting the company's new public status, with no material adverse impacts or red flags identified.
